summary: Verified GA4 consent-gated analytics on LeadNation preview. All three PASS criteria satisfied: (a) no GA network requests before consent; (b) after clicking 'Accept All' the gtag/js?id=G-H5809GHQXW script loaded and window.gtag became a function (dataLayer populated with 4 entries); (c) a GA collect hit to google-analytics.com/g/collect carrying tid=G-H5809GHQXW fired (page_view). SPA navigation to /tools produced additional collect hits (user_engagement + subsequent page_view tracking).

test_evidence.console_401_error_note: One 401 console error observed (unrelated to analytics, likely an auth API probe). Does not affect GA loading.

critical_code_review_comments: analytics.js: acceptAll flow works correctly and applyConsent() properly loads scripts. Note: trackPageView() calls window.gtag directly; since gtag is only set on consent, pre-consent trackPageView calls silently no-op (correct GDPR behavior).
context_for_next_testing_agent: GA4 consent gating verified end-to-end on preview URL with REACT_APP_GA4_ID=G-H5809GHQXW. Use network request interception (page.on('request')) with fresh localStorage (remove 'ln_cookie_consent') to reproduce.
